subject: CAIQ response matrix and evidence staging for Cythera Health
messages:
From: Jill Harper <jill.harper@cythera.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Cc: Samir Patel <samir.patel@cythera.com>
Date: Fri, 10 Jan 2026 09:14:00 -0800
Subject: CAIQ intake - mapping and evidence scope

Hi Vanessa,

Thanks again for taking this on. We completed our initial security review and need Redwood’s CAIQ responses mapped to the Cloud Controls Matrix controls. Specifically:

- A completed CAIQ spreadsheet with a control-by-control answer (Y/N/Partial) plus a short rationale for any Partial/No responses.
- An evidence index that lists artifacts, owners, and expected access paths (logs, screenshots, runbooks, runtime traces).
- Clarify coverage across your deployment modes (hosted API, Dedicated, Private) and any control differences.

Our compliance window for the assessment is Jan 22. Could you confirm a delivery plan and whether you need anything from our side (scope boundaries, test accounts, or IP allowlists)?

Attachments: Cythera_CAIQ_Request.pdf (request template)

Regards,
Jill Harper
Head of Security Assurance, Cythera Health
jill.harper@cythera.com

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Jill Harper <jill.harper@cythera.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 10 Jan 2026 11:02:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: CAIQ intake - mapping and evidence scope

Hi Jill — thanks for the clear ask. We can deliver a control-level CAIQ matrix and an evidence index that ties artifacts to controls. Proposed plan: 

1) Today: confirm scope (hosted-only vs hosted + dedicated/private).
2) By Jan 15: deliver RA_CAIQ_v1.xlsx (control answers + short rationale) and a stubbed evidence index.
3) By Jan 20: final evidence bundle (PDF index + links + temporary staging access).

Quick notes on coverage: hosted API and Dedicated align on controls for telemetry and runtime; Private deployments have additional attestations around customer-managed keys and network boundaries which we will mark separately in the spreadsheet.

Ask for you: please confirm whether we should include Private (on-prem/VPC) in the assessment scope. If you need a test tenant for hosted verification, share the IP ranges to allow.

I’m attaching the initial RA_CAIQ_v1.xlsx (draft) and will loop Kimberly and Marissa to collate artifacts.

Attachments: RA_CAIQ_v1.xlsx (draft)

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Director, Security Programs | Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 10 Jan 2026 13:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Internal: Cythera CAIQ - evidence owners and quick tasks

Kimberly / Marissa / Jordan — quick internal sprint so we hit Cythera’s Jan 22 window. Summary:

- Kimberly: take point for controls related to key management, KMS/HSM evidence, and on-prem/private deployment notes. Deliverable: short attestation snippets + any diagram/screenshots.
- Marissa: assemble the evidence index (CAIQ_Evidence_Index.pdf) with artifact owner, location (Drive link), retention window, and redaction notes. Prioritize runtime logs (KV cache traces, prefix cache behavior), API audit logs, and deployment manifests.
- Jordan: validate the control rationales in RA_CAIQ_v1.xlsx — pay attention to Partial answers where we depend on customer configuration for Private deployments.

Staging access: we will create a temporary read-only staging bucket and a shared folder. I’ll attach the access instructions file. Also record a 3-min screen capture showing where to pull runtime snapshots for the auditor (screen_recording_stub.mp4).

Let’s target an internal check-in Monday 10:00 PST and a send-to-customer Tuesday afternoon (Jan 12).

Thanks — V

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Jill Harper <jill.harper@cythera.com>
Cc: Samir Patel <samir.patel@cythera.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Jan 2026 16:02:00 -08:00
Subject: Fwd: CAIQ response matrix and evidence staging for Cythera Health

Hi Jill — following up with the deliverables we discussed. Attached are: RA_CAIQ_v1.xlsx (control answers + rationale) and CAIQ_Evidence_Index.pdf (artifact index). We also provisioned a short staging access guide and a recording that shows how to pull runtime traces.

Notes/highlights:
- We marked Private deployments as a separate column in the matrix; where control coverage depends on customer-managed keys or network config, the cell is "Partial" with a short rationale and the required customer action.
- Evidence index points to drive folders and includes owner contact for each artifact; items marked "on request" (logs) will be staged with read-only access for your auditors for a two-week window.
- If you want a signed attestation for any assertions, flag them and Kimberly will prepare the sign-off bundle.

Related links: https://hubspot.redwood/deals/DEAL-8943 (deal record), https://drive.google.com/fake-folder/ca iq-staging (evidence folder)

Attachments: RA_CAIQ_v1.xlsx, CAIQ_Evidence_Index.pdf, staging_access_instructions.txt, screen_recording_stub.mp4
